verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is an inference engine and server, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence pack documents only `llama serve`, a web UI, a CLI and GBNF grammars. Nothing shows an official MCP server that an agent could connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
